criteria.succeeds: evidence/docs-owed.md lists each owed page with its type and check, or states that none is owed
criteria.fails: a page that names the changed thing is missing from evidence/docs-owed.md

criteria.succeeds: every row of evidence/docs-owed.md has its page written or fixed
criteria.fails: a row of evidence/docs-owed.md has no matching page change

criteria.succeeds: the page's commands ran in a scratch environment and the project's docs gate output is green
criteria.fails: a page command was never run in a clean environment, or the project's docs gate fails

criteria.succeeds: evidence/cold-read.md shows a final read with no stuck step
criteria.fails: the last read in evidence/cold-read.md still has a stuck step

criteria.succeeds: one PR holds the pages and both evidence files, with the docs gate output in its description
criteria.fails: the PR lacks an evidence file or the docs gate output
